name: dropdown-menu
purpose: Overlay menu that opens from a consumer-supplied trigger and renders a list of selectable options grouped into named sections. The root `DropdownMenu` owns open/closed state, positioning, focus return, and keyboard navigation; `DropdownMenu.Trigger` wires `aria-haspopup`/`aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` onto whatever element the consumer passes through its slot; `DropdownMenu.Group` groups options under an optional label; `DropdownMenu.Option` is the selectable row with left/right/command affordances. Replaces and removes the legacy monolithic input `dropdown` and the previous `dropdown-menu` composition — there is one `DropdownMenu` in the project, in `navigation/`.
useWhen: A menu of actions opened from a button: row actions, an account menu, an overflow ("more") menu.
Options grouped under section labels, optionally with keyboard-shortcut hints.
avoidWhen: Choosing a value that a form submits → use `select` (inside a `field` for a label).
A primary action joined to a menu of alternatives → use `split-button`.
A searchable palette of commands → use `command`.
Free-form or interactive content such as forms or filters → use `popover`.
related: split-button` — composes `DropdownMenu` for its chevron menu.
select` — form control with a field trigger and a bound value.
popover` — same trigger and anchoring model, with free-form content instead of option rows.
command` — modal ⌘K palette with search and filtering.
bestPractices: Give every `DropdownMenu.Option` a unique `value` and handle the root `select` event as `(event, value)`. The panel closes and focus returns to the trigger on its own.
selected` is a display flag. The dropdown never sets it, so derive it from your own state.
Use the `command` prop or the `right` slot on an option, not both. A `command` shortcut is live only while the panel is open.
Add a `label` to each `DropdownMenu.Group` when there is more than one group. Put search in the root `top` slot and footer actions in `bottom`; those regions stay outside the scrolling list.

props.name: open
props.doc: Controlled open state. Use with `v-model:open` or `@update:open`. When omitted, the component is uncontrolled.

props.name: placement
props.doc: Where the panel opens relative to the trigger. `'auto'` picks the best-fitting corner at open time based on viewport space.

props.name: offset
props.doc: Pixel gap between the trigger and the panel.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Prevents the trigger from opening the panel and applies disabled tokens.

events.name: update:open
events.notes: Fires on every open/closed transition; supports `v-model:open`.

events.name: select
events.notes: Fires when an enabled option is activated (click, `Enter`/`Space`, or a `command` shortcut). `event` is the activation event; `value` is the activated option's identifier. The panel closes automatically and focus returns to the trigger when activated from inside the open panel.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: Place `<DropdownMenu.Trigger>` followed by one or more `<DropdownMenu.Group>`.

slots.name: top
slots.notes: Sticky region rendered above the scrollable group list (e.g. search input).

slots.name: bottom
slots.notes: Sticky region rendered below the scrollable group list (e.g. footer action).

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DropdownMenu, {
    DropdownMenuGroup,
    DropdownMenuOption,
    DropdownMenuTrigger
  } from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu'
  import IconButton from '@aziontech/webkit/icon-button'
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenu>
    <DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <IconButton
        kind="outlined"
        icon="pi pi-plus"
        aria-label="Open menu"
      />
    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
    <DropdownMenuGroup>
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="profile"
        label="Profile"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="settings"
        label="Settings"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="billing"
        label="Billing"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="invite"
        label="Invite members"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="logs"
        label="Audit log"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="signout"
        label="Sign out"
      />
    </DropdownMenuGroup>
  </DropdownMenu>
</template>

examples.name: Groups
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DropdownMenu, {
    DropdownMenuGroup,
    DropdownMenuOption,
    DropdownMenuTrigger
  } from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu'
  import IconButton from '@aziontech/webkit/icon-button'
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenu>
    <DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <IconButton
        kind="outlined"
        icon="pi pi-plus"
        aria-label="Open menu"
      />
    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
    <DropdownMenuGroup label="Account">
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="profile"
        label="Profile"
        command="⌘P"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="settings"
        label="Settings"
      />
    </DropdownMenuGroup>
    <DropdownMenuGroup label="Workspace">
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="invite"
        label="Invite members"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="logs"
        label="Audit log"
        selected
      />
    </DropdownMenuGroup>
  </DropdownMenu>
</template>

examples.name: States
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import DropdownMenu, {
    DropdownMenuGroup,
    DropdownMenuOption,
    DropdownMenuTrigger
  } from '@aziontech/webkit/dropdown-menu'
  import IconButton from '@aziontech/webkit/icon-button'
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenu :open="true">
    <DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <IconButton
        kind="outlined"
        icon="pi pi-plus"
        aria-label="Open menu"
      />
    </DropdownMenuTrigger>
    <DropdownMenuGroup label="Option states">
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="default"
        label="Default"
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="selected"
        label="Selected"
        selected
      />
      <DropdownMenuOption
        value="disabled"
        label="Disabled"
        disabled
      />
    </DropdownMenuGroup>
  </DropdownMenu>
</template>
